goal: Build recoverable current-canvas knowledge anchors, fused local retrieval and a fail-closed sensitive-content boundary for canvas chat and explicit canvas tools.
non_goals: Do not implement Task 17 evidence navigation, linear projections or saved views.
Do not move credentials to Windows Credential Manager; Task 19 owns credential storage.
Do not make cross-canvas retrieval the default or include evidence from previous-message source canvases.
Do not require a model or network for keyword search and evidence listing.
Do not rewrite authoritative CanvasDocument content when extraction or indexing fails.
acceptance_criteria: Task 15 indexing persists revision-scoped recoverable anchors for supported canvas content and isolates extractor failure with redacted retry errors.
Current-canvas retrieval fuses keyword, semantic, entity and time evidence, supports optional reranking and returns 没有找到 when evidence is insufficient.
Canvas chat defaults to the captured sourceCanvasId and never cites nodes from another canvas without an explicit cross-canvas tool call.
Sensitive values are detected locally and replaced with stable typed placeholders before every cloud-classified request.
Raw sensitive context is allowed only for direct non-proxied http/https loopback endpoints; malformed, LAN, redirected or proxied destinations fail closed.
Focused tests, Canvas regression, TypeScript, production build, independent review and exhaustive L2 impact pass.
notes: Use test-first implementation and keep ordinary audit reporting concise.
Default retrieval is strictly captured current-canvas evidence; cross-canvas access requires explicit user intent and a separate tool call.
The loopback raw-context policy is fail closed for proxy use, redirects, malformed URLs and every non-loopback host.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for Chinese text such as 没有找到 and other non-ASCII edits.
